preservation_rule: Only these exact paths may evolve after their original bytes are archived and verified. Source snapshots and fit/input locks remain unchanged. Raw responses/manifests, historical data, models, scientific estimates and protocols are never exempted.
model_policy: Render existing frozen results only. No refit, no recalibration, no new learner or prospective performance scoring.
display_policy: One canonical report and dashboard, explicit method/source/timing/sample labels. Older scientific reports and ZIPs remain unchanged; original navigation and entrypoints are archived with hashes.
